tests.title: Frozen-input and object authority
tests.requirement: Exact approved proposal content/field limits; candidate/variant registration only after authorization; no new tokens, breakpoints, reference-local logic or artwork.

tests.title: Blank and source provenance
tests.requirement: No preselected mappings/route/text; four source versions/limits visible; inspections alone cannot complete; synthetic designation persistent.

tests.title: Criterion mapping structural bounds
tests.requirement: All four states; missing with explicit gap and zero supports accepted; unknown/stale/duplicate links rejected; conflicting requires distinct support/limiting records; two-artifact integration is not a quality score.

tests.title: Text and route boundaries
tests.requirement: Four routes structurally recordable; 45/46 and 35/36 words, 600/601 characters, empty/punctuation/one/two Letter-Number T boundaries; over-limit retained; no route correctness, word minima or keywords.

tests.title: Initial immutable recommendation
tests.requirement: Capture exact evidence versions, mappings, route/text once; earlier record unchanged by later edits; inspect exact route consequence/common contrast.

tests.title: Clarification timing and consequences
tests.requirement: No U01 before firstRecord+C; release exactly once; E03v1 historical and E03v2 current; no fake live request/assessor attribution; unresolved limitations retained.

tests.title: Invalidation matrix
tests.requirement: Change every substantive source/link/state/gap/priority/route/text; immediately clear current review/ack, preserve initial; whitespace equivalent no bump; explicit Revise invalidates before edit.

tests.title: Reconsideration and challenge
tests.requirement: Retain and amend both supported; current version confirmation for three criteria required; changed route optional; retain does not force new prose; amend cannot be whitespace-only. No stale mapping can silently become current.

tests.title: Completion truth
tests.requirement: Each E/M/J/C/U/R/F individually necessary; not yet outcomes complete practice; storage/export/all-sufficient not required; no public approval/credential fields become true.

tests.title: Automatic recovery
tests.requirement: Refresh after every mapping/text/decision/review update including incomplete/over-limit/IME content; reconstruct current/historical versions and recompute completion; forged completion bit ignored.

tests.title: Opt-in, corrupt/conflicting restore
tests.requirement: Explicit Save on this device; real profile restart, explicit resume; deny/quota, wrong schema/case/contract, stale snapshot, divergent tiers/tabs, clear cancellation/failure; no overwrite or completion; other activities untouched.

tests.title: Retained representation
tests.requirement: Selectable/copy/download includes exact dossier versions, criteria/limits/gaps, first/current judgments, rationale/next action and practice-only status; failures truthful; no Hub receipt.

tests.title: Responsive/max-content
tests.requirement: 1920x1080,1440x900,1024x768,768x1024,390x844,320x568,844x390; all maxima, 180-character labels, long tokens, all disclosures expanded; no horizontal page scrolling/clipping/destructive overlap; row-to-source return and comparison reachability.

tests.title: Keyboard/focus/non-color
tests.requirement: Full native-control flow without pointer/drag; logical reading/tab order, source return focus, first invalid field association, no trapped disclosure, states labelled by text; contrast and motion checks.

tests.title: Genuine Chrome 200% — direct
tests.requirement: Native indicator plus full map→recommend→consequence→U01→reconsider→ack→revise/re-review flow; inspect full feedback and reachable Continue; user/direct evidence only.

tests.title: Actual screen reader — direct
tests.requirement: Reader/OS/browser/version/performer; criterion/source reading order, link roles, changed version, missing/conflicting state, gap priority, not-yet consequence, current/historical outcomes, truthful practice completion.

tests.title: Physical-mobile keyboard — direct
tests.requirement: Device/OS/browser/performer; two text fields, caret/focus/scroll under software keyboard, long paste, error, dismissal, reconsideration and Continue reachability.

tests.title: Resilience
tests.requirement: Reduced motion, blocked fonts, offline after load, missing JS honest dossier fallback, Unicode/IME/pasted HTML inert, storage/clipboard denial. No source-media dependency.

tests.title: Burden and differentiation — human
tests.requirement: Observe 8–12 minute hypothesis and two-field/80-word current ceiling; record actual navigation/effort. Reject nested stage tabs, repeated criterion essays or studio-like scrolling even if tests pass.

tests.title: Independent semantic H01–H10
tests.requirement: Human review each positive fixture and negative counterexample; no automated semantic PASS. All ten dimensions require verdict/rationale and exact fixture hash.

tests.title: Evidence provenance
tests.requirement: Automated, user-attested and independent/ChatGPT review separate. GR06 200% attestation does not transfer. Pending checks stay pending; target after automation is IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_MANUAL_VALIDATION.

tests.title: System compatibility/integrity
tests.requirement: Repository/schema/registry, GR01/04 exact locks, GR03 423, complete GR05/GR06 suites; new candidate/model/service binding tests, all syntax, default/variant compatibility and package ZIP. Service unchanged; fail extensions as TA-G03, no local workaround.

human_rubric.title: Evidence-to-criterion fit
human_rubric.requirement: Each link actually supports or limits its own criterion, not a convenient document count.

human_rubric.title: Contradiction and absence
human_rubric.requirement: Unsupported receipt/approval claims and untested access remain visible; missing is not forced into sufficient.

human_rubric.title: Quality versus completion
human_rubric.requirement: Four artifacts, opened sources and valid fields do not establish capability.

human_rubric.title: Uncertainty and scope
human_rubric.requirement: A synthetic rehearsal and clarification support only bounded claims; no population or delivery inference.

human_rubric.title: Authority
human_rubric.requirement: Peer practice, author self-review, tutor review, public decision authority and credentials remain distinct.

human_rubric.title: Proportionate next step
human_rubric.requirement: Remediation is feasible, owned and matched to the gap, with a point for reconsideration.

human_rubric.title: Version-dependent assessment
human_rubric.requirement: New E03 invalidates the current outcome; old reasoning is retained as history, never silently current.

human_rubric.title: Agency in not yet
human_rubric.requirement: Revise, defer and seek review are legitimate; work is preserved and the next route is understandable.

human_rubric.title: Concise meaningful reasoning
human_rubric.requirement: The two brief fields explain enough without filler; structured mappings reduce burden. No generic repeated boilerplate.

human_rubric.title: Honest completion and differentiation
human_rubric.requirement: Practice completion is not competence judgment; no keyword/minimum-word grading; experience is substantially lighter than GR05/06.
